items.item_text: A valid driver’s license or equivalent alternate form of transportation to off-site meetings and events is required.
A minimum of two years of research experience with at least one co-authored publication.
Experience collecting data from neurodiverse and clinical populations.
An interest in or prior experience with data collection involving the study of autonomic psychophysiology.

Experience performing advanced statistical modeling and analysis with longitudinal and multivariate datasets, including multi-level modeling (MLM), structural equation modeling (SEM), latent profile analysis, causal mediation, and related techniques.
Facilitate community engagement and study recruitment.
Support the development and management of the Center’s research registry.
Prepare Institutional Review Board (IRB) materials and coordinate IRB submissions and relevant communications.
Collaborate with the PI to design research studies, including independent projects.
Supervise data collection activities.
Support and oversee data entry and management.
Assist in supervising undergraduate and graduate student research projects.
Prepare research findings for presentation and publication.
A Ph.D. in Clinical or Developmental Psychology or a closely related field is required.
Established research reliability in the administration and scoring of the Autism Diagnostic Observation Schedule-2 (ADOS-2).
Proficiency in statistical software and programming languages (e.g., SPSS, MPlus, R).
Demonstrate an understanding of, and appropriate adherence to, research ethics and codes of conduct.
Ability to attend to detail, multi-task, and use effective time management, planning, and organizational skills to perform responsibilities accurately and to meet expected deadlines.

Ability to cultivate an inclusive environment including a commitment to mentoring students and supporting clients representing a broad range of socioeconomic backgrounds, political opinions, genders, races, ethnicities, nationalities, sexual orientations, religions, and developmental and behavioral functioning.
Ability to follow instructions and to delegate appropriate tasks effectively.
Ability to work efficiently, cooperatively, and collaboratively with others.
Ability to receive and respond appropriately to constructive criticism.
Ability to communicate effectively verbally and in writing.
Knowledge of standard computer software such as Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).

pay.source_text: The anticipated pay range is $35.00 - $40.00 per hour. Pay rate will be commensurate with experience and qualifications.
